result.instructions: Tools for SendGrid, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SendGrid data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run sendgrid_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sendgrid_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sendgrid_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. sendgrid_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sendgrid_ping
tools.title: Ping (health check)
tools.description: Health check — verifies the API key works and returns the scopes (permissions) granted to it. SendGrid: GET /v3/scopes.

tools.name: sendgrid_list_templates
tools.title: List email templates
tools.description: List your transactional email templates (Dynamic and/or Legacy). Returns { result: [...], _metadata } — use _metadata.next / page_token to paginate. SendGrid: GET /v3/templates.

generations.description: Which template generation(s) to return (default: dynamic).

page_size.description: Number of templates per page (1–200, default 50).

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's _metadata.

tools.name: sendgrid_get_template
tools.title: Get email template
tools.description: Get a single transactional email template by id, including its versions (subject + content). SendGrid: GET /v3/templates/{template_id}.

template_id.description: The template id (dynamic template ids start with "d-").

tools.name: sendgrid_list_marketing_lists
tools.title: List marketing lists
tools.description: List your Marketing Campaigns contact lists, each with its id, name, and contact_count. Returns { result: [...], _metadata }. SendGrid: GET /v3/marketing/lists.

page_size.description: Number of lists per page (1–1000, default 100).

page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous response's _metadata.

tools.name: sendgrid_get_contact_count
tools.title: Get contact count
tools.description: Get the total number of Marketing Campaigns contacts on your account. Returns { contact_count, billable_count }. SendGrid: GET /v3/marketing/contacts/count.

tools.name: sendgrid_search_contacts_by_email
tools.title: Search contacts by email
tools.description: Look up marketing contacts by exact email address (a read-only lookup — mutates nothing). Returns { result: { "<email>": { contact: {...} } } }. SendGrid: POST /v3/marketing/contacts/search/emails.

emails.description: One or more exact email addresses to look up.

tools.name: sendgrid_get_stats
tools.title: Get email stats
tools.description: Get global email statistics over a date range (delivered, opens, clicks, bounces, spam reports, etc.). Returns an array of { date, stats: [{ metrics: {...} }] }. SendGrid: GET /v3/stats.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today).

aggregated_by.description: How to group the returned statistics.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination).

tools.name: sendgrid_list_bounces
tools.title: List bounces
tools.description: List bounced email addresses (the bounce suppression list). Returns an array of { created, email, reason, status }. SendGrid: GET /v3/suppression/bounces.

start_time.description: Start of the time range, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

end_time.description: End of the time range, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

offset.description: Number of bounces to skip (for pagination).

email.description: Filter to a specific bounced email address.

tools.name: sendgrid_list_global_unsubscribes
tools.title: List global unsubscribes
tools.description: List globally-unsubscribed email addresses (the global suppression list). Returns an array of { created, email }. SendGrid: GET /v3/suppression/unsubscribes.

start_time.description: Start of the time range, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

end_time.description: End of the time range, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

offset.description: Number of records to skip (for pagination).

tools.name: sendgrid_send_mail
tools.title: Send email
tools.description: SENDS A REAL EMAIL immediately via SendGrid. Provide `from_email` and one or more `to` recipients, plus EITHER a subject + content OR a `template_id` (dynamic template ids start with "d-", pass values via dynamic_template_data). Returns { status: "accepted", message_id }. SendGrid: POST /v3/mail/send.

from_email.description: Sender email address (must be a verified sender/domain).

to.description: One or more recipient email addresses.

subject.description: Email subject line. Required unless a template_id supplies it.

content_type.description: MIME type of the body content (default text/html).

content.description: The email body. Required unless template_id is provided.

template_id.description: A template id to render (dynamic template ids start with "d-"). When set, `content` is omitted.

dynamic_template_data.description: Key/value data merged into a dynamic template's handlebars variables.

tools.name: sendgrid_add_or_update_contacts
tools.title: Add or update marketing contacts
tools.description: UPSERTS marketing contacts (creates new ones, updates existing ones by email) and optionally adds them to lists. This is an ASYNC job — returns { job_id } you can poll. SendGrid: PUT /v3/marketing/contacts.

email.description: Contact email address (required — the primary identifier for the contact).

items.description: A marketing contact. `email` is required; first_name/last_name are optional. Any additional keys are passed through as custom-field values (use the custom field's id or reserved name as the key).

contacts.description: Contacts to add or update (each needs an `email`; custom fields pass through).

list_ids.description: List ids to add these contacts to.
